Hi {{contact.first_name}}, here is everything for the day in one place. Keep this handy.

The plan

• Date: {{contact.event_date}}

• Start time: {{contact.event_start_time}}

• Event: {{contact.event_type}} · about {{contact.guest_count}} guests

• Venue: {{contact.venue_name}} {{contact.venue_address}} ({{contact.indoor_or_outdoor}})

• Package: {{contact.package_interest}} · add-ons: {{contact.addons_requested}}

• We arrive: about {{custom_values.setup_time_required}} before your start time to set up. Setup and teardown are outside your booked hours.

Money

• Quoted total: {{contact.quoted_amount}}

• Deposit: {{contact.deposit_status}} · Balance: {{contact.balance_status}}

If the balance shows anything other than Paid, the invoice is in your email and text messages. It is due {{custom_values.balance_due_days_before_event}} days before the event.

Before we arrive

• Clear the setup area: {{custom_values.space_requirement_footprint}}, {{custom_values.space_requirement_height}} overhead

• Have {{custom_values.power_requirement}} reachable from the setup spot

• Tell us where to park and unload: {{contact.access_notes}}

• Outdoors? Plan cover. {{custom_values.weather_policy_summary}}

On the day

Our team runs everything. One swing at a time, everyone else behind the line, kids with an adult. Reply to any of our texts or call {{custom_values.business_phone}} if plans change.

See you soon.
